description: This Java class defines a REST controller named HealthController that provides a health check endpoint at '/health'. It uses Spring Boot annotations to expose an HTTP GET endpoint returning a JSON payload indicating the service status.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A REST controller that exposes a health check endpoint at '/health'. It is annotated with Swagger tags for API documentation.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns a simple JSON response with status 'ok', indicating the service is healthy.
